name: Banh hoi
summary: Bánh hỏi is Phong Điền’s fine rice vermicelli, finished with sautéed garlic. It comes under the charcoal pork of nem nướng Cái Răng.
howToEat: Eat it with nem nướng, the grilled pork skewers.
where: Lunch plates of nem nướng in town after the market.
seoDescription: Phong Điền’s fine rice vermicelli with sautéed garlic, served under nem nướng Cái Răng.
